scope: Additive TH18 Spell Tower L1-L4 mode inventory and partial mechanics record. No defensive-spell proxy is materialized before mode-specific trigger, effect and lifecycle ordering are reproducible.
game_version: The frozen source payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell confirms the TH18 L4 Earthquake slot but does not identify a client build; current secondary mechanics are version-unknown.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
sources.limitations: Confirms two Home Village towers at TH15 and that L1 Rage boosts nearby defenses/units, L2 makes Poison selectable against nearby enemies, and L3 temporarily conceals nearby defensive units/buildings. It does not publish numerical geometry, duration, recharge, deployment delay, effect selection, cancellation, destruction, collision or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: December Balance Changes
sources.limitations: Confirms Poison Tower attack-rate reduction is 25%. It does not specify pulse cadence, duration, target geometry, movement reduction, interaction or ordering.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: Confirms current Rage Tower radius 5 and damage boost 60%. It does not specify duration, trigger, recharge, buff stacking, movement multiplier, target filtering or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: Confirms TH18 Spell Tower L4 unlocks the Earthquake spell slot and Earthquake now damages ground troops. It publishes no defensive Earthquake trigger, pulse schedule, target selection, falloff, cooldown or ordering.

sources.title: Home Village Spell Tower structured payload
sources.limitations: Pins L1-L4 HP/unlocks and the four mode parameter rows. It has no independent client build or combat trace; its values remain secondary and cannot resolve target-selection, cast, projectile, collision or ordering rules.

sources.title: Spell Tower
sources.limitations: Reports 1.2-second activation delay, effect/recharge parameters, destruction casting and broad mode behavior. It does not identify a current build or define tick-level acquisition, projectile flight, pulse boundaries, stacking, visibility/collision, destruction/simultaneous-event ordering or restoration behavior.

value.confidence: primary qualitative/balance corroboration plus frozen structured payload and version-unknown secondary mechanics
not_materialized: mode selection validation and source-verified visual variants
Poison projectile, pulse, slow and overlap boundaries
Invisibility damage-trigger, concealed recipient and targeting/collision contract
destruction cast, recharge timing, simultaneous-event ordering and snapshot/replay state

partial_mechanics_contract.note: The importer retains each frozen source mode parameter explicitly. This contract records the official corrections and blocks Core materialization of generic offensive spells as a substitute for defensive lifecycle rules.

support.note: All L1-L4 modes remain unavailable through Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshots and replays until their defensive trigger/effect lifecycle is source-reproducible.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines the current fixed-tick order among enemy entry, 1.2-second casting delay, target loss, tower destruction, spell impact, recharge and simultaneous spells/traps.
No source defines precise effect inclusion at 4.5/4.7/5/9-tile boundaries, effect collision/line-of-sight, multi-tower stacking or duration refresh.

Rage movement/attack-speed effect, Poison pulse/overlap and Invisibility targeting/collision are not sufficiently specified to reuse attacker spell logic. Earthquake defensive pulse and diminishing-hit state cannot be inferred from player-cast Earthquake semantics.
Current source-verified effect assets, projectile paths and animation-to-rule-tick mapping remain absent.
conclusion: Spell Tower L1-L4 now has an additive, provenance-complete parameter record; its four modes remain data-only. Existing player spell rules are deliberately not reused as an undocumented defensive proxy.
